newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Cellular extends offer for its notes.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Cellular extends offer for its notes.

text.p: Horizon Cellular Telephone Co LP said on Tuesday its offer to purchase its 11-3/8 percent senior subordinated discount notes due 2000 scheduled to expire Monday has been extended until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT Friday, September 20.
As of the close of business on September 16, tenders with respect to approximately $41.9 million principal amount of notes had been received, the company said.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette is dealer manager.
